assumptions: A result at one fixed block size is not treated as a capacity converse.
Only finite auxiliary supports are covered; no reduction from general auxiliary spaces is assumed.
The established binary-input reduction equating the single-use Marton sum functional with randomized receiver scheduling is treated as an external premise.
The usual Marton inner-bound theorem for finite discrete two-receiver channels is treated as an external premise under the mean decoding-error criterion.

facts.condition: Provided the standard finite-channel Marton coding theorem, a finite-block auxiliary construction can be flattened into codes for the original channel while preserving its per-symbol sum-rate conclusion.

Restricting every auxiliary variable to finite support, joining independent block constructions makes the block objective superadditive; its normalized asymptote therefore equals its supremum across finite block sizes.

If the binary-input single-use reduction is assumed, the one-use finite Marton optimum matches the receiver-switching benchmark; with Marton achievability also assumed, an n-block law improves that benchmark exactly when its unnormalized objective exceeds n copies of the benchmark.
For the canonical channel, the receiver-switching benchmark is attained at the smaller stationary root of a quadratic equation, and its entropy-form evaluation admits a directed-arithmetic enclosure.

rootContract.objective: Determine the exact private-message sum-capacity C_sum of the half-skew binary skew-symmetric broadcast channel specified by the canonical problem.

referenceCommunity.description: A counterfactual community of competent human mathematical researchers collaborating on the canonical BSSC objective, with its program and thread portfolio defined exclusively by the bound builder-v6 knowledge projection.
referenceCommunity.researcherQualification: For each local work package, a researcher with graduate-level mathematical maturity and the information-theory, probability, optimization, or computer-assisted proof expertise needed to begin productive work without general disciplinary training, but without unpublished solution-specific knowledge.

rootContract.terminalCondition: A validity-v4 accepted result establishes one exact value of C_sum by matching rigorous achievability and converse bounds, including every limiting, cardinality, and certification condition needed for the canonical channel.

workUnit.definition: One focused person-hour of research by a researcher qualified for the relevant work package, using the fixed conventional tool baseline named by this contract.
workUnit.toolBaseline: Public mathematical literature and standard non-autonomous research tools available as of 2026-08-25, including handwritten reasoning, symbolic algebra, numerical computation, interval arithmetic, proof assistants, and code execution on commodity research hardware; autonomous LLM or agent labor is excluded.

updates.rationale: The accepted repair supplies the finite-auxiliary definition, super-symbol achievability reduction, superadditivity argument, limiting construction, exact randomized-time-division threshold, and a reproducible directed certificate. This removes most foundational and threshold-validation work at the program level while leaving integration and selection of the next multiletter construction unresolved. The repaired foundation also modestly strengthens the case for pursuing this program.

The submission explicitly repairs the previously unsettled finite-foundation agenda by stating the necessary external hypotheses, proving the finite super-symbol reduction and limit, and replacing the uncertified threshold with a directed interval certificate.

The exact criterion comparing a finite multiletter law against the certified randomized-time-division benchmark removes setup and normalization work from future witness searches. The submission supplies no improving witness and expressly leaves the residual three- and four-symbol two-letter search open, so substantial search work remains; the now-rigorous criterion makes that search somewhat more likely to be pursued.
